tool: Raster composition of files that live in this repository (a scriptable image tool; the outputs carry cHRM, bKGD and date text chunks from the re-encoder and nothing else). No new imagery was generated; every pixel derives from the listed inputs and the flat canvas colour.
composedAt: 2026-09-15T19:20:43Z (tIME chunks of the app showcases); the contact sheets carry no timestamp
operator: Universal Profiles design-system maintainer (role; no personal name is recorded)
license: The two background-overview contact sheets contain only generated-background pixels and follow the Apache-2.0 terms in LICENSES/GENERATED-IMAGES.md. The two app-showcase previews are mixed compositions: their generated-background pixels follow those generated-image terms, while their embedded app-screen pixels retain the owner-rights, documentation-and-presentation-use-only terms in assets/screenshots/mobile-app/PROVENANCE.json. The app-showcase files are therefore not wholly covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 grant. All four previews are for the README gallery and for choosing files; they are not delivery masters.
rightsNote: Derived previews. Regenerate from the inputs rather than editing; the validator measures every preview against its declared inputs so the pictures can never drift from the files they show.
postProcessing: None beyond the composition itself: backgrounds scaled to fit, screens scaled to about 299 by 634 (the measured best fit of a 300 by 636 target) with a soft shadow, contact-sheet thumbnails scaled to 600 by 338 on a #121B21 canvas (the dark canvas token surface.canvas). The contact sheets were saved at 16 bits per channel by the tool; the showcases at 8.

contract.description: Checked by node scripts/validate.mjs --only rasters: every declared input exists and is listed in its own PROVENANCE.json, and every declared placement matches the input within a mean absolute difference of 6 of 255 after scaling

assets.description: Three app screens over the light title background at 1920 by 1080: home at the left, the in-app browser raised in the middle, the deployment success screen at the right (measured: it matches the success file more closely than the preparing file); the left half is free for copy.
